title: Cross-Currency Payments
key_points: Cross-currency payments in XRP Ledger allow for the transfer of value across different currencies.
They are built on top of the decentralized exchange (dex) feature and utilize XRP as the quote currency.
The payee specifies the amount and destination, while the payer specifies the amounts to be sent in each currency.
This allows for a more efficient process than having to find an external market for each currency pair.
limitations: Limited information provided about the specific technical implementation details.
Does not cover all potential use cases or edge cases of cross-currency payments.
Assumes some prior knowledge of XRP Ledger concepts and terminology.
asserts: Cross-currency payments in the XRP Ledger enable efficient transfer of value across different currencies by leveraging the decentralized exchange feature and utilizing XRP as the quote currency.
scope: Explains how cross-currency payments work within the context of the XRP Ledger, focusing on the decentralized exchange feature and how it allows for transfers between different currencies.
